LanguageData.GunplayEnableSoundsDesc: Change fire and projectile impact sounds for some weapons. May require restart.
LanguageData.GunplayEnableWeaponAnimationsDesc: Animate weapons like miniguns and bows, and also animate weapon movement for pawns missing their targets.
LanguageData.GunplayEnableEffectsDesc: Show visual effects for projectiles impacting targets.
LanguageData.GunplayShowPuffsDesc: Show dust and smoke puffs spawned when projectiles impact surfaces.
LanguageData.GunplayParticleMultiplierDesc: Multiplies the number of particles spawned by impact effects. Default 100%, range 5% to 400%, in 5% steps.
LanguageData.GunplayProjectileSpeedEnabledDesc: When enabled, Projectile speed applies to all projectiles. When disabled, every projectile keeps its own def's original speed. Arcing projectiles (grenades, shells) are never scaled, so this does not affect them.
LanguageData.GunplayProjectileSpeedDesc: Alter speed to specified percentage for all projectiles.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailLengthDesc: Trail length is this value multiplied by the projectile's own (unscaled) speed, so faster projectiles get longer trails. By default a bullet with speed 70 gets a 10.5 tile trail. Default 15, range 1 to 120. Applies only to projectiles fired afterwards.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailFadeDesc: How many ticks the trail takes to shrink away after the projectile is gone, in ticks (60 ticks = 1 second). Independent of trail length. Default 15, range 1 to 120. Applies only to projectiles fired afterwards.
LanguageData.GunplayArcSegmentCountDesc: How many segments an arcing trail (grenades, mortar shells) is split into. Higher is smoother and costs more. Default 16, range 2 to 64.
LanguageData.GunplayEnableArcTrailsDesc: Draw arc trails for vanilla (non-CE) arcing projectiles such as mortar shells and grenades. When disabled these projectiles get no trail; straight and CE projectiles are unaffected. Applies only to projectiles fired afterwards.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthModeDesc: Determines how the base trail width is calculated.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthModeDamage: Trail width: based on projectile damage
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthModeTexture: Trail width: based on projectile texture size
LanguageData.GunplayTrailWidthFactorDesc: Multiplies the calculated trail width. Default 100%, range 5% to 400%, in 5% steps.
LanguageData.GunplayCEStraightTrailsDesc: Draw straight trails for Combat Extended projectiles; lobbed projectiles (mortar shells, grenades) get no trail. When disabled, all CE projectile trails follow their actual flight path instead (arc style).
LanguageData.GunplayUnarmedEffectsDesc: Give projectiles fired without a weapon (turret shots, scripted projectiles) bullet trails and impact sounds/effects.
LanguageData.GunplayUnarmedBulletsOnlyDesc: When enabled, only weapon-less projectiles dealing Bullet damage get these effects.
LanguageData.GunplayProjectileOverridesDesc: Override the trail material, width, length, fade duration and color of individual projectiles, and whether each projectile is affected by the global projectile speed. Trail values are absolute and ignore the material and the global trail settings above.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialDesc: Shape, width profile, color and geometry of each trail material (one material per ProjectileTrailDef). Changes apply instantly.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialPickTip: Pick the trail material to edit (one material = one ProjectileTrailDef).
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialResetTip: Discard every edit to this material and go back to the values in its def (XML).
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialSourceTip: The generated texture is built at runtime from the shape and width profile parameters below. A file texture uses the image referenced by the def's graphicData instead, and the shape parameters and width profile do not apply (they are greyed out).
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialNoTexture: This material has no usable texture
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialProfileTip: Visible width as a fraction of the trail quad (0-1). Both ends are relative: at generation time the wider one is stretched to 1, so the widest point always fills the quad and the trail width setting is never silently changed. Equal values = uniform width (identical to the old look); a smaller tail = the tail tapers away; a larger tail = the tail flares out.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialProfileCurveTip: Curve of the width transition: 1 = linear along the whole length; higher pushes the change towards the tail (the head stays wide and only the tip tapers or flares); lower pushes it towards the head.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialColorTip: Color of this material. Color is not baked into the texture (it is passed per batch), so recoloring does not rebuild anything, but it only affects projectiles fired afterwards.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialWidthTip: When checked, this material uses an absolute width in world units. Otherwise the width is the base width (damage/texture mode) times the global width multiplier. Checking starts at 0.15.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialLengthTip: When checked, this material uses an absolute length factor (length = value x projectile speed). Otherwise the global "Trail length" setting applies.
LanguageData.GunplayTrailMaterialFadeTip: When checked, this material uses an absolute fade duration in ticks. Otherwise the global "Trail fade duration" setting applies.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideClearAllConfirm: Clear all {0} per-projectile overrides ({1} of them come from removed content and are not listed)? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipMaterialPicked: This projectile uses a material picked here: {0}. Click to pick another one, or "Clear" to inherit again. Press and drag over other rows to give them this material.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipMaterialInherited: This projectile inherits the material configured on its def: {0}. Click to pick a material just for it. Press and drag over other rows to give them this inherited material.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipMaterialMissing: The material {0} picked for this projectile no longer exists; it currently falls back to the inherited material: {1}. Click to pick another material, or use "Clear" to drop the dead entry.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipColor: Customize this projectile's trail color. Clicking the swatch on a row that is not overridden yet enables the override automatically; × restores the inherited trail color. Press on a swatch and drag over other rows to paint the same color onto them.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideColorResetTip: Clear the custom color and inherit the trail color again.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipEnabled: Override the trail settings of this projectile. Turning this off discards the override, restoring inherited/calculated values. You can also press on a row and drag up or down to switch the rows you sweep over.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipTrail: Draw a trail for this projectile. When off, this projectile gets no trail at all and its width override goes unused. Adjusting this on a row that is not overridden yet will enable the override automatically. You can also press on a row and drag up or down to set the swept rows the same way.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipSpeed: Whether this projectile is affected by the global projectile speed. Not overridden, it shows the default: arcing projectiles (grenades, shells) are never scaled. Clicking enables the override automatically. The master switch above stops all scaling while off. You can also press on a row and drag up or down to set the swept rows the same way.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipWidth: Trail width in world units. Absolute value, ignores both the width mode and the width multiplier. Hold Shift and drag to paint this row's value onto the rows you sweep over.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipLength: Trail length is this value multiplied by the projectile's own (unscaled) speed. Absolute value, ignores the global trail length. Hold Shift and drag to paint this row's value onto the rows you sweep over.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideTipFade: How many ticks the trail takes to shrink away after the projectile is gone, in ticks (60 ticks = 1 second). Absolute value, ignores the global fade duration. Hold Shift and drag to paint this row's value onto the rows you sweep over.
LanguageData.GunplayOverrideNoResults: No projectiles match the current filter.
